rollups.text: Tennis: The user played tennis weekly with friends as of 2023-03-05 and played for fun rather than professional-player inspiration; Roger Federer was a favorite (2023-03-05; T13, T21). The user planned park tennis with friends on 2023-03-12 (2023-03-12; T19) and 2023-07-30 (2023-07-30; T401), and described an every-other-week routine in July. The user owns Nike Air Zoom tennis shoes (date unspecified; T15), chose Nike Court Flex Tennis Socks but did not confirm buying them (2023-03-11; T17), mainly plays from the baseline and was practicing volleys and overheads (2023-03-11; T23), and considered buying a tennis bag without choosing one (2023-07-30; T411, T412).

Dance and movement classes: The user took a hip-hop class at a local community center on 2023-01-10 and learned a routine to an Ariana Grande song, gaining confidence during class (2023-01-10; source ID not supplied). By 2023-04-08, the user had taken Saturday salsa classes for about two months and said they increased energy (T93, T97). The user also attended Saturday-morning ballet with Madame Dupont by 2023-04-28, appreciating the instructor’s detailed teaching and improvements in posture, balance, flexibility, and technique (source ID not supplied). The user planned to learn a routine to Ariana Grande’s “Thank U, Next” and considered practicing with their sister (2023-04-28; source ID not supplied).

Yoga: The user missed a usual yoga class after waking late on 2023-03-05 and planned to seek an early-morning class the next day (2023-03-05..2023-03-06; T1, T3). By 2023-07-24, after about six weeks of regular practice, the user enjoyed yoga and had tried Hatha, Vinyasa Flow, and Restorative Yoga; they wanted to explore more styles focused on flexibility and balance and considered future teacher training (2023-07-24; T380, T382, T386, T388, T390).

Books and reading interests: The user finished Alex Michaelides’s The Silent Patient on 2023-03-15 and chose Liv Constantine’s The Last Mrs. Parrish as the next book, seeking psychological thrillers with dark characters, dark humor, and social commentary; the user was also interested in Fiona Barton and Clare Mackintosh (2023-03-15; T25, T29, T31, T33, T35). On 2023-06-21, the user said they had read The Hate U Give by Angie Thomas and The Song of Achilles by Madeline Miller, was interested in contemporary fiction about diversity and cultural identity, and looked forward to R. F. Kuang’s The Poppy War. The user attended a reading by Emma Taylor, obtained a signed copy of The Lost City, and was interested in its cultural and identity themes (2023-06-21; T294, T296, T298, T302, T304).

Handmade goods and markets: The user makes handmade, eco-friendly candles and knitted scarves and sold them at a community-center craft fair during 2023-03-20..2023-03-26, reporting repeat customers and a positive experience (date range; source ID not supplied). The user attended the local library Artisan Market on 2023-04-10 and reported great feedback on the candles (2023-04-10; T105). The user considered expanding candle scents and colors, including a summer lavender-and-lemon line, and preferred rustic countryside styling for product photos (2023-03-30..2023-04-11; source IDs not supplied). The user considered applying to the June 2023 Summer Solstice Fair (June 2023; T105, T106).

Travel plans and trips: The user planned a Las Vegas concert trip with friends for 2023-05-20 and expected to stay at the Bellagio, expressing interest in its Conservatory and Fountains and considering a Penicillin cocktail at The Dorsey (2023-03-27..2023-05-20; T59, T61, T63, T65, T67, T68, T69). On 2023-07-04 the user said they had checked out of a Marriott in San Francisco and was asking about Chicago attractions and shops (2023-07-04; T326, T330, T332, T334, T336). The user was planning a Spain trip “soon” and sought Spain-focused Spanish practice and cultural information, but gave no dates or itinerary (2023-07-20; T362, T364, T366, T370). The user considered a spring 2024 western U.S. national-parks road trip, especially the Grand Canyon and Yellowstone, but did not confirm it or specify an itinerary (2024-03-01..2024-05-31; T239, T241).

Senior Marketing Manager opportunity and preparation: On 2023-03-10, the user said HR had shortlisted them for a Senior Marketing Manager position, calling it a major milestone (source ID not supplied). On 2023-03-17, the user attended a company leadership workshop covering communication, conflict resolution, and strategic planning (source ID not supplied). By 2023-05-29, the user was preparing for the role, reflecting on past projects, planning a personal SWOT analysis, and seeking to improve leadership, communication, and specific actionable feedback; the conversation did not establish that the user was hired. The preparation continued at least 80 days after the shortlist and 73 days after the workshop.

Apartment move and walking: Around 2023-05-09, the user moved into a new apartment; by 2023-05-30 they said they loved it and that the shorter commute provided about 30 extra minutes in the morning for coffee and news (T233, T237, T241). By 2023-05-30, the user was incorporating more walking into daily life and had discovered parks and previously unknown cafes; they asked for walking routes and tracking apps (T237). The walking exploration was reported about 21 days after the approximate move date.

Web-based commercial appraisal report application: On 2023-07-25, the user was developing an application for writing commercial appraisal reports and sought a typical report structure (T396). The user then moved to Step 4, calculation tools for property value, cost approach, and sales comparison approach, specifying industry-standard methods customizable to user preferences and asking to assume implementation was complete; next they moved to Step 5, report export to PDF, Word, and Excel (T397, T399). These steps occurred within the same day; no later completion status was recorded.

Japanese cooking and dinner party: The user had been taking Japanese cooking classes since April 2023 and experimenting with ingredients including mochiko flour (T245, T255). For a dinner party planned for the weekend of 2023-06-03..2023-06-04, the user planned Salmon Teriyaki, Chicken Yakitori, steamed vegetables, Japanese rice, and Mochi Brownies with a mochi topping, hoping to use skills from class (T245, T247, T253, T255). On 2023-06-02, the user sought advice on teriyaki sauce, preparing yakitori and salmon, and mochi topping consistency (T247, T248, T249, T250, T251, T252, T256). The planning and recipe questions were recorded the day before the planned party; whether it took place is not established.

Meditation and stress management: On 2023-06-11, the user was looking for ways to manage stress and anxiety and had researched mindfulness and meditation. They planned to try Headspace Take10 and had bookmarked relevant Insight Timer meditations, while noting that noisy family members could make it difficult to find a quiet place (T269, T271, T273). The user said their doctor recommended a serotonin supplement and planned to discuss meditation and the supplement at a follow-up, begin gently, monitor for adverse effects, and discuss dosage adjustments with the doctor (T269, T275, T277, T279). The record contains an inconsistency: the user described starting the supplement in mid-June and also said they had already taken it for a month, despite the session being dated June 11. No subsequent outcome is recorded.

Web project: On 2023-07-02, the user described a five-person team building a web project emulating bxgs.co.kr, with an April 16 deadline whose year was not specified. The user had studied back-end and front-end programming for four months, mainly Java and JavaScript, and had learned JSP and servlets (T306). Desired features included membership, login/logout, product search and listings, reviews, shopping cart, member-information changes, inquiries, and purchasing; the user planned to use Oracle (T308). The discussion developed a proposed database schema with tables and keys, and the user requested explanations of primary and foreign keys (T309, T311, T312, T313). The deadline cannot be sequenced reliably against the July 2023 discussion because its year is unspecified.

rollups.text: The records explicitly document two planned tennis meetups with friends at the local park: one for 2023-03-12 and one for 2023-07-30. The user also described weekly tennis with friends as of 2023-03-05 and an every-other-week routine by July, but these are frequency descriptions rather than a complete count of sessions.

The user reported two successful homemade popcorn experiments: spicy Korean-inspired gochujang-and-soy popcorn around 2023-06-17..2023-06-18, and lemon-herb popcorn with lemon zest and dried thyme by 2023-07-02. The user also said they had tried paprika, garlic powder, and chili powder, without giving dates or a count of separate batches.

Morning routine and exercise: On 2023-03-06, the user was trying to establish a 6:30 a.m. wake-up routine every day, including weekends, and said it had been difficult but was becoming more manageable (T5). On 2023-03-05 they had missed their usual yoga class after waking late, and the next day planned to find an early-morning class (T1, T3). On 2023-05-30, the user said they had rejoined their old gym in April and had been building a regular exercise routine, while asking how to stay motivated and avoid burnout (T235). The record does not confirm that the early-waking goal was maintained or that later motivation advice was adopted.
